derivation.behavior: Completion actions are decided once by engine and executed idempotently by host.
derivation.canonical_behavior: Go emits idempotent platform request only when canonical terminal conditions are met.

checks: Idempotency key is derived from canonical download/artifact/outcome/action identity.
Duplicate records return the existing action without mutating revision.
Host accepted/declined replies are stored durably.
Destructive actions require explicit host approval before platform execution is requested.
